gloss: to pursue; to seek after; to chase

definitions.gloss: to pursue; to seek after; to chase (a dream or ideal)
definitions.explanation: To keep striving after something hard to reach, such as a dream, an ideal, or happiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める。

examples.english: He kept pursuing his ideal sound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}う→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you chase only profit, you can lose sight of what matters.

notes:
⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (chase) + ⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (seek). The object is usually abstract.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める: to pursue a dream
- ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める: to pursue an ideal
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める: to seek happiness
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める: to seek the truth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pursue (profit, happiness) — more formal and written
- ⟦{追|お}いかける→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧: to chase a person or moving thing; also figurative (⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかける→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧)
